overview: Passage padhkar inference, main idea, tone, suitable title, what author would agree/disagree.
coreConcept: Sirf passage me diye evidence ko use karo, apna knowledge nahi.
hinglishExplanation: Pehle question padho, phir passage me evidence dhundo. Options me extreme words (always, never, only) se savdhan. Main idea sabse broad option jo poore passage ko cover kare.
formalDefinition: Sirf passage me diye evidence ko use karo, apna knowledge nahi.
importantProperties: Main idea: poora passage cover kare.
Extreme words wale options usually galat.
